summary: Mobile/PWA validation pass for Convoy. Backend pytest suite extended from 25 to 31 tests, all 31 PASS. Frontend verified on iPhone 13 (390x844) and Pixel 5 (412x915) viewports against the live preview URL. PWA assets (manifest/sw/icon) reachable, service worker registers, all head meta-tags present. Help, SOS, participants overview, marker popup nav buttons (Google/Apple Maps), self-marker hides nav, account deletion all work end-to-end. Help placeholder verified to contain 'lost the route'. One minor visual issue: Emergent badge geometrically overlaps the bottom help/SOS bar — buttons remain functionally clickable (Playwright real click confirms), but the badge sits on top of the row visually.

minor.issue: Intermittent 500 from upstream object-store (https://integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore) during image upload — flaky, retry usually succeeds. ~1/40 hit during this run.

issues: #emergent-badge (z-index:9999, fixed bottom:16px right:16px overridden by JS to horizontally centered) visually overlaps the help/SOS bar (badge top≈798/869 vs button top≈792/863). Buttons still receive clicks via Playwright real-click, but the 'Made with Emergent' pill sits on top of the gap between I NEED HELP and SOS. Consider lifting the bottom bar above the badge or hiding the badge on the participant dashboard.

'YOU' badge is rendered immediately adjacent to the team name without a whitespace/separator in the DOM text node — visually OK because of CSS, but innerText reads e.g. 'T7 · MyTeamYOU'. Suggest wrapping 'YOU' in a span with margin-left or aria-label='You'.

action_items: [Minor design] Fix Emergent badge / help-SOS bar overlap on small viewports (raise bottom bar z-index above 9999, or push badge below bar via padding-bottom on body, or hide badge on participant dashboard).
[Cosmetic] Add a separator or inline-block span around the 'YOU' label in overview-row so DOM text remains readable.
[Resilience] Optionally retry image upload on 5xx from upstream objstore — the route currently returns 500 to the client when the storage service blips.

[Carry-over] CORS still uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True (invalid per spec) — flagged in iteration_1, still present. Bearer fallback masks it but cookie auth across origins won't work.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/auth/me correctly cascades user, registrations, and password-reset tokens — verified via test.
GET /api/events for admin returns ALL events (cross-admin) — verified.
emergency_phone Form field stored on event, returned via GET /api/events/{id} — verified.
help_message persists when status in (help/sos) and is wiped to empty on clear — verified.
Owner can self-leave their registration via DELETE /api/registrations/{id} — verified; old test that asserted 403 was updated to assert 200 to match the new product behaviour.
MapView popup correctly hides Google/Apple navigation buttons for the user's own marker (verified via DOM check on hasGoogle/hasApple).

InstallPrompt component is correctly gated by isStandalone() and recentlyDismissed(); iOS branch fires after 4s timer and shows the Share→Add to Home Screen instructions; Android branch waits for beforeinstallprompt.
Service worker registers with scope '/' and active scriptURL points to /sw.js — verified live.
test_credentials: admin@roadtrip.com / admin123 (seeded). Test participants generated per-test via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed events/users/registrations and clean up the events created during the run via DELETE /api/events.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_roadtrip_api.py — run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. New classes: TestNewFeatures (emergency_phone, help_message, cross-admin events visibility), TestAccountDeletion (DELETE /api/auth/me + re-register), TestPWAStaticFiles (manifest/sw/icon). Cleanup test_owner_can_self_leave replaced the old 403 assertion. Frontend mobile flows verified by injecting localStorage 'rt_token' from API-acquired participant token, then loading '/' on small viewports. Use page.context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) + set_geolocation before opening the participant dashboard so the Wake Lock / location push subsystem doesn't error.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional regressions found. Only minor visual overlap between Emergent badge and bottom help/SOS bar; flagged as a design issue, not a blocker.
